**Title:** Mycenaean stirrup jar (Μυκηναϊκός ψευδόστομος αμφορέας)
**Type:** Pottery (Κεραμική) / Storage vessel (Αγγείο αποθήκευσης)
**Material:** Clay (Πηλός)
**Time Period:** 1300 BC - 1200 BC [Mycenaean Period (Μυκηναϊκή περίοδος)]
**Location Found:** Mycenae (Μυκήνες)
**Dimensions:** Height: 32.0 cm
**Inventory Number:** FME-0007

**Description:**
Closed transport jar with a false spout and three handles, painted with horizontal bands and a row of stylised octopus tentacles in lustrous red-brown paint. Intact apart from a repaired handle. Such jars carried perfumed oil across the Aegean.

**Subjects & Themes:**
Bronze Age (Εποχή του Χαλκού), Trade (Εμπόριο), Aegean pottery

**Title:** Gold solidus of Justinian I (Χρυσό σόλιδο Ιουστινιανού Α')
**Type:** Coin (Νόμισμα) / Numismatic object (Νομισματικό αντικείμενο)
**Material:** Gold (Χρυσός)
**Time Period:** 527 AD - 565 AD [Byzantine Period (Βυζαντινή περίοδος)]
**Location Found:** Thessaloniki (Θεσσαλονίκη)
**Dimensions:** Diameter: 2.0 cm, Weight: 4.4 g
**Inventory Number:** FME-0008

**Description:**
Obverse: helmeted bust of the emperor facing, holding a globus cruciger. Reverse: a winged Victory standing, holding a long staff surmounted by a Christogram. Minted at Constantinople and found in the fill of a Byzantine cistern in Thessaloniki.

**Subjects & Themes:**
Numismatics (Νομισματική), Byzantine empire (Βυζαντινή αυτοκρατορία)

**Title:** Carved iconostasis fragment (Τμήμα ξυλόγλυπτου τέμπλου)
**Type:** Woodcarving (Ξυλογλυπτική) / Church furnishing (Εκκλησιαστικό σκεύος)
**Material:** Wood (Ξύλο), gilding (επιχρύσωση)
**Time Period:** 1820 AD - 1840 AD [Post-Byzantine Period (Μεταβυζαντινή περίοδος)]
**Location Found:** Ioannina (Ιωάννινα)
**Dimensions:** Height: 58.0 cm, Width: 41.0 cm
**Inventory Number:** FME-0009

**Description:**
Pierced relief panel with a vine scroll enclosing two facing peacocks, originally part of the lower zone of a church screen. Traces of gilding survive in the recesses. Attributed to a workshop of Epirot woodcarvers active around Ioannina.

**Subjects & Themes:**
Woodcarving (Ξυλογλυπτική), Religion (Θρησκεία), Epirus (Ήπειρος)

**Title:** Roman glass unguentarium (Ρωμαϊκό γυάλινο μυροδόχο)
**Type:** Glassware (Υαλουργία) / Container (Δοχείο)
**Material:** Glass (Γυαλί)
**Time Period:** 1 AD - 100 AD [Roman Period (Ρωμαϊκή περίοδος)]
**Location Found:** Patras (Πάτρα)
**Dimensions:** Height: 9.4 cm
**Inventory Number:** FME-0010

**Description:**
Small free-blown bottle of pale green glass with a long neck and a folded rim, used for perfumed oil. Iridescent weathering covers most of the surface. Found in a cemetery of the Roman colony at Patras, placed beside the head of the deceased.

**Subjects & Themes:**
Glass (Υαλουργία), Funerary customs (Ταφικά έθιμα), Roman period
